product_overview: HirebridgeHR is a multi-tenant applicant tracking system and candidate career portal for recruiters, hiring teams, and candidates. It supports job management, candidate tracking, pipeline progression, interviews, reporting, and candidate job search/application workflows.
core_goals: Sign in as a recruiter or candidate and access the appropriate portal
Create and manage job requisitions for hiring needs
Search and manage candidates across the talent database
Move candidates through a hiring pipeline and monitor stage progression
Browse jobs as a candidate and submit applications
Review recruitment performance through dashboard and reports

features.name: User Authentication
features.description: Recruiters and team members can sign in, and users can use demo persona quick-fill actions to access the app.
user_flows: Navigate to /signin -> Fill in email -> Fill in password -> Submit sign-in form -> See dashboard
Navigate to /signin -> Use a demo role quick-fill action -> Submit sign-in form -> See dashboard
Navigate to /signin -> Toggle password visibility -> Enter credentials -> Submit sign-in form -> See dashboard

features.name: Candidate Portal Authentication
features.description: Candidates can sign in to the candidate portal or move from login to registration.
user_flows: Navigate to /candidate/login -> Fill in candidate email and password -> Submit login form -> See candidate dashboard
Navigate to /candidate/login -> Switch to sign up tab -> Fill in registration details -> Submit sign-up form -> See candidate dashboard

features.name: ATS Dashboard
features.description: Recruiters can view hiring metrics, recent activity, and time-based dashboard insights.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard -> View hiring statistics cards -> View recent activity feed -> Review hiring overview
Navigate to /dashboard -> Change the timeframe filter -> View updated metrics -> Review revised dashboard insights

features.name: Job Management
features.description: Recruiters can search jobs, create new requisitions, and save or publish postings.
user_flows: Navigate to /jobs -> Search and filter jobs by department, status, or location -> Review matching job list -> Open a job for review
Navigate to /jobs -> Start creating a new job -> Fill in title, department, salary, and requirements -> Save as draft -> See the new job listed
Navigate to /jobs -> Start creating a new job -> Fill in title, department, salary, and requirements -> Publish the job posting -> See the job available in the list

features.name: Candidate Management
features.description: Recruiters can search candidates, open candidate profiles, and record evaluation notes and ratings.
user_flows: Navigate to /candidates -> Search candidates by keyword, skill, or stage -> Review filtered candidate results -> Open a candidate profile
Navigate to /candidates -> Open a candidate profile -> Add evaluation notes -> Assign a rating -> Review the updated candidate record

features.name: Hiring Pipeline Kanban
features.description: Recruiters can view candidates by stage, filter the pipeline by job posting, and move candidates through hiring stages.
user_flows: Navigate to /applications/pipeline -> View candidate cards by stage -> Drag a candidate to the next stage -> See the updated pipeline board
Navigate to /applications/pipeline -> Filter the pipeline by a specific job posting -> Review the stage columns for that job -> Move a candidate to another stage -> See the board reflect the change

features.name: Interview Management
features.description: Recruiters can review scheduled interviews and create new interviews for candidates.
user_flows: Navigate to /interviews -> View scheduled interviews -> Filter interviews by status or interviewer -> Review the filtered interview list
Navigate to /interviews -> Schedule a new interview with a candidate -> Review the interview entry in the schedule list

features.name: Candidate Portal Job Search
features.description: Candidates can search available jobs, save roles for later, and submit applications.
user_flows: Navigate to /candidate/jobs -> Search openings by title or location -> Review matching jobs -> Open a job listing
Navigate to /candidate/jobs -> Open a job listing -> Save the job for later -> See the job marked as saved
Navigate to /candidate/jobs -> Open a job listing -> Start the application process -> Submit the application -> See confirmation in the candidate applications tracker
